mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate signals weakening consumer demand, reducing earnings expectations and depressing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising unemployment are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals weakening demand, reducing corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of falling consumption are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of tightening above 2.5% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals a significant labor market weakening, reducing earnings expectations and depressing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of unemployment above 4.5% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) below 2.0% signals a demand contraction, reducing corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of consumption growth below 2.0% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% combined with a 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) below 2.0% signals a severe macroeconomic downturn, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of unemployment above 4.5% and consumption growth below 2.0% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) below 2.0% combined with a 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a demand contraction and monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of consumption growth below 2.0% and funds rate above 2.5% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
